'''SN-D1''' was a [[Service droid/Legends|service droid]], who was working at the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Droid Spa/Legends|spa]] as an attendant on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
SN-D1 was voiced by [[Angelique Perrin]], who also voiced [[BO-N1/Legends|BO-N1]] in the same episode.
